01 Three words

Three words, and what they mean in practice

We do not ask you to take them on trust. Each one is backed by something you can check on this site today.

Intelligent

An engine that calculates, not a chat that reassures.

Innovative

The Pure Digital model: repetition automated, expertise kept.

  • Orders, reorders, invoices, tracking and returns live in your account, with no office hours.
  • Tools built for the salon: quick order, colour calculator, profitability on every product page.

Impartial

The same rules for everyone who uses the platform.

  • Prices are set by role and shown before you order: no sales reps, no price lists on request, no negotiation person by person.
  • Advice follows the formula and the protocol, not the margin: fewer wrong purchases, less waste.
  • Every brand is presented with the same data: INCI, protocol, cost per service. A correction enters the platform because it has been verified, whoever sends it.

03 The origin

Distribution first. Then the platform.

cliCHair started where two trades that rarely talk to each other met: a master colorist with years of technical work behind the chair, who knows the real limits of a product because she has used it on her clients’ hair, and a developer convinced that a salon’s decisions could be calculated rather than guessed.

  • 2018

    ÜLTIMA hair concept

    For years we worked as a professional distributor in the classic way: salon visits, samples, printed price lists. That period taught us the trade from the inside, and showed us precisely which parts of the job were real expertise and which were simply repetition.

  • The platform

    cliCHair

    We automated the repetition and kept the expertise. The method did not come after the technology: the technology was built to run the method.

  • The engine

    clichAIr

    The calculation engine the platform is named after, on every page of the site and on the messaging channels you already use.

  • Today

    A platform that evolves

    Every release has a number and a date. What changed, and what it changes for you, is on the Updates page.

05 The principle

Depth, not breadth

The difference is not how many products you find. It is how well we know them.

We work with a small number of complete professional ranges, technical and colour lines included, studied down to the last INCI. A generalist assortment offers you a few retail references. Here you find the whole range, with the application protocol for every single reference and the cost per service.

This is also why the technical lines stay reserved for professionals: it protects your expertise in the salon and keeps professional references out of online price wars.

06 The engine

clichAIr

It is not a support chat. It is the calculation engine the platform is named after.

If you run a salon

  • Dosages per application and cost per service
  • How many applications you get from one pack, and how profitable a kit is
  • Orders, reorders and requests, 24 hours a day

If you buy for yourself

  • It reads the INCI lists and checks that the products you combine are compatible
  • It builds the right routine for your hair, so you stop buying by trial and error
  • How long a product lasts and what it costs per use

AI does not decide on its own

Every formula goes through our team of experts, every protocol through technical verification in the field. Nothing enters the platform without that check.

The platform does not learn on its own and does not learn from the web: it grows only on what the team has verified. And when a question goes beyond its limits, clichAIr hands over to our team.

08 The value

The value stays where the work is

Platform automation lowers our structural costs, and we do not keep those savings: they become the price you see. No inflated price list with apparent discounts layered on top.

Each channel has its own terms, calculated on the role of the buyer and on the real value of the product. Two salons with the same profile see the same price: it does not depend on who calls more often or negotiates harder.

And no strings attached: no contracts, no punitive minimum orders. If you already have a supplier you trust, keep them. cliCHair also works well as a complementary channel, for urgent needs and for testing new lines.

Request your terms

09 Education

A product performs as well as the hand that applies it

A technical product on its own is not enough. That is why we run in-person professional courses alongside the platform, built together with the manufacturers.

We hold courses and events regularly, and we open dedicated sessions when a group of salons shares the same technical interest. Write to us with the subject that interests you and we will let you know as soon as dates open.

Write to us about training
